title: 美银Vinny Wu：中国AI三篮子，出口链为何最稳？
speaker: Vinny Wu

segments.en: Yes sure certainly I mean that's a lot of investor currently are asking you know China AI how good is monetization
segments.zh: 好的，确实现在很多投资者都在问，中国AI的商业化变现能力到底如何

segments.en: and what if US AI slows down right can we still own Chinese stocks
segments.zh: 以及如果美国AI降温，我们还能不能继续配置中国权益资产

segments.en: I think the ability of the China market is we've seen a growing pie of the investable universe right
segments.zh: 我认为中国市场的机会在于，可配置的标的池正在不断扩大

segments.en: because of the technology development and because of these new listings or deal listings so we group them into three buckets right
segments.zh: 这得益于技术发展以及一批新上市标的，所以我们把它们分成三个篮子

segments.en: with different you know risk return profiles the first bucket are the exporters right
segments.zh: 它们有不同的风险收益特征，第一个篮子就是出口链

segments.en: those sell to the US AI infrastructure AI DC build out right those will be the optical transceivers PCBs turbines
segments.zh: 它们供货给美国AI基础设施和AI数据中心建设，包括光模块、PCB、涡轮机

segments.en: you know power supply cooling the beauty of those are those are proven success right whether it's technologically or earnings wise or earning visibility perspective
segments.zh: 还有电源、散热，这些公司的优势在于已被验证的成功，无论是技术、盈利还是盈利可见度

segments.en: and they've done some of them have done very well I guess the risk is they are highly correlated with the US
segments.zh: 其中一些表现非常好，但风险在于它们与美国市场高度相关

segments.en: and you know in that sense it's highly correlated with career Taiwan tech stocks so it doesn't give you as much diversification
segments.zh: 从这个意义上说，它们与台湾科技股也高度相关，所以分散效果有限

segments.en: the second bucket is the AI localization story right those will be the domestic factory memory AI accelerator equipment
segments.zh: 第二个篮子是中国AI本地化，包括本土晶圆厂、存储、AI加速器和设备

segments.en: those domestic names many of them are still the strategic bottleneck for China right so they are well aligned with the policy priority
segments.zh: 这些本土公司很多仍是中国战略瓶颈，因此与政策优先级高度契合
